description: Creates a new label with a specified name (required) and color on a Trello board (idBoard required); this action defines the label but does not apply it to cards.

color.description: Color for the new label. Valid values: green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue, sky, lime, pink, black (and their _dark/_light variants). If not specified, the label will have no color (color=null).
color.title: Color

idBoard.description: ID of the board for the new label. Must be a 24-character hexadecimal TrelloID (e.g., '60d5f2d97f5f8c008d3e9d6b'). Note: The 8-character shortLink from board URLs is NOT accepted by this endpoint. Required by the Trello API.
idBoard.title: Id Board

name.description: Name for the new label (0-16384 characters). **Required by the Trello API.** An empty string creates a color-only visual label.
name.title: Name

name: add_labels

data.description: The full details of the newly created label.
data.title: Data

AddLabelsResponseData.description: Details of the newly created label.

color.description: The color of the label (e.g., 'green', 'red', 'blue', 'purple', 'orange', 'yellow', 'sky', 'lime', 'pink', 'black'). Null if no color was specified.
color.title: Color

id.description: The unique identifier of the newly created label (24-character hex string).
id.title: Id

idBoard.description: The ID of the board the label belongs to.
idBoard.title: Id Board

name.description: The name of the label. May be an empty string for color-only labels.
name.title: Name

uses.description: Number of cards currently using this label.
uses.title: Uses

AddLabelsResponseData.title: AddLabelsResponseData
